subtitle: Out Manila · Air China
overview: This 9-day no-shopping tour flies Air China from Manila via Beijing to Urumqi, then travels north to Altay, Hemu and Kanas Lake, west to Sayram Lake and Yining, and on to the Nalati grasslands before flying back through Beijing. You stay in 5-star hotels, with a whole roasted lamb meal in Xinjiang and a Beijing outlet-mall stop on the last day.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Nov 4–12 2026 to Dec 9–17 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

Guests should plan their free time sensibly to avoid delays. Before choosing any entertainment or extra activities at scenic spots, understand the details and precautions, choose according to your physical condition and follow the safety instructions.
Xinjiang runs on a different daily rhythm from other cities in China; for example lunch is usually around 2:00 PM and activities are scheduled between about 9:00 AM and 8:00 PM.

Xinjiang food is mainly spicy and flavourful, with beef and mutton, and may not suit every taste; avoid eating it together with raw or cold foods, and avoid eating fruit with hot tea. Day and night temperatures differ greatly.

Please do not walk barefoot in the bathroom or shower; use non-slip mats and non-slip, waterproof slippers, and place the shower curtain inside the bathtub. After checking in, check the room facilities, hot and cold water and drainage, and tell the guide or driver at once if anything is wrong.
Xinjiang has beautiful scenery, but local hotels and services are limited, so please do not expect too much; getting a good night's sleep is the most important.

placeDesc.Urumqi International Grand Bazaar: A large market complex in Urumqi with Uyghur crafts, dried fruit and local food.
placeDesc.Tianchi Lake: A glacial alpine lake in the Tianshan Mountains near Urumqi, visited with entrance and shuttle included.
placeDesc.S21 Desert Highway: A scenic highway across the Gobi desert on the way north from Urumqi.
placeDesc.Ahe Highway: A scenic mountain road in northern Xinjiang on the way to Hemu.
placeDesc.Hemu Village: A wooden Tuva village in the Altai mountains of northern Xinjiang.
placeDesc.Hemu Bridge: A bridge in Hemu with views of the river and surrounding forest.
placeDesc.Haden Viewing Platform: A viewing platform above Hemu offering wide views of the valley and mountains.
placeDesc.Kanas Lake National Forest Park: A mountain lake and forest park in the Altai region, known for its bays and changing colours.
placeDesc.Fairy Bay: A scenic bay on the Kanas River, a popular photo stop in Kanas Lake park.
placeDesc.Moon Bay: A curved bend of the Kanas River in the shape of a crescent moon.
placeDesc.Colorful Beach: A riverside beach in the Kanas area known for its coloured stones and views.
placeDesc.Urho World Devil City: A Yardang landscape of wind-carved rock formations in the Gobi near Karamay.
placeDesc.Karamay Oilfield: A well-known oilfield scene on the roadside, passed on the drive.
placeDesc.Sayram Lake: A large high mountain lake in the Tianshan, toured all the way round.
placeDesc.Guozigou Valley: A scenic valley and bridge route in the Tianshan on the way to the Ili region.
placeDesc.Yangbulak Folk Village: A folk village in the Ili region, visited for local culture.
placeDesc.Swan Spring: A spring and wetland area in the Ili valley.
placeDesc.Nalati Sky Grassland: A high grassland in the Tianshan near Nalati, famous for its wide open pastures.
placeDesc.Nalati River Valley Grassland: A river valley grassland near Nalati with open pastures and scenery.
placeDesc.Kazanchi Folk Village: A folk village in Yining area known for its local houses and culture.
placeDesc.Beijing Springs Outlets Mall: An outlet shopping mall near Beijing, visited after lunch on the last day.
